cur-fossil-cerro-fortaleza.dateNote: In 2005 Kenneth Lacovara's team found the bones of a giant long-necked dinosaur in Santa Cruz Province, Argentina. Named Dreadnoughtus in 2014, it is one of the most complete giant sauropods. The rock is about 75 million years old (Late Cretaceous). Wikidata pins the formation at a rounded point.
cur-fossil-cerro-fortaleza.summary: Where one of the most complete giant dinosaurs, Dreadnoughtus, was dug up in Patagonia.

cur-find-pilauco.dateNote: A footprint in southern Chile, about 15,600 years old, is probably human, which would make it one of the oldest signs of people in the Americas (Moreno et al., PLOS ONE, 2019).
